mutants.name: remote-unpicked-no-connect
mutants.old: if want == nil, shown.contains(r.pane), paneRemote(r.pane) != nil { refused.insert(r.pane) }

mutants.name: remote-outside-cap
mutants.old: if let k = want, taken.contains(k) || room == 0 { refused.insert(r.pane) }
mutants.new: if let k = want, taken.contains(k) || (room == 0 && paneRemote(r.pane) == nil) { refused.insert(r.pane) }

mutants.name: remote-fit-here
mutants.old: guard remoteHost == nil, phase == .live, child != nil, let grid, let p = sessionPty, p.clients > 1 else { return false }
mutants.new: guard phase == .live, child != nil, let grid, let p = sessionPty, p.clients > 1 else { return false }

mutants.name: same-key-dead-client-respawns
mutants.old:
guard key != self.key else { return }
        focusPending = false
mutants.new:
guard key != self.key || (key != nil && child == nil) else { return }
        focusPending = false
